name: CRUX: adversarial re-verification of the four BP10 builder legs
note: Tier: referee (Fable 5.1). Read-only on product files. Self-cap: 25 turns. Permission fence: scoped `git add` + `git commit` only; push/merge/checkout/reset denied; use `cd <path> && git status --short`, never `git -C`. Commit code BEFORE the receipt; the receipt is your final write. Budget discipline: run /token-saver first and keep to it - Select-String / grep for symbols, read 40-line windows around cited lines, never whole files; the two source docs are your brief, read them ONCE in full at the start and then only grep them. Houdini GUI is NOT available to you: anything that needs a live panel is UNKNOWN, never a pass. hython IS available at `C:\Program Files\Side Effects Software\Houdini 22.0.400\bin\hython.exe` (22.0.400) for headless gates. Minimal diff: touch only the files in `touches`. House rule: no number enters a document without a producer path beside it. Every UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN - never a pass, never a 0. The JEV-SCREEN line in your brief (if present) tells you where evidence is thin; it never removes a read. Nothing merges on a BROKEN.
targets: T1) Per builder receipt: re-run every non-GUI acceptance predicate in a fresh checkout of the leg branch; verdict rows pass|fail|UNKNOWN with your own anchors.
T2) >= 2 self-authored mutations per builder leg, each named with the check it reddens -> harness/battleplan/notes/BP10-CRUX_mutations.json
T3) harness/battleplan/notes/BP10-CRUX_verdicts.md: one verdict per leg (SOUND | SOUND-WITH-NITS | BROKEN) plus the screen-vs-CRUX agreement line per leg.
T4) Licence audit row: confirm no SideFX help text is tracked by git and the vendored LICENSE is byte-identical to upstream.

acceptance.predicate: one verdict per builder leg (four) with independently re-run rows and the crucible's own anchors
>= 2 self-authored mutations per builder leg, each named with the check it reddens
screen-vs-CRUX agreement line present for all four legs
licence audit row present: no EULA text tracked, LICENSE hash matches upstream

crucible_criteria: the crucible trusts no builder's proved_it_bites - it authors its own mutations
every verdict row carries the crucible's own anchor
a leg with any UNKNOWN acceptance is at best SOUND-WITH-NITS, never SOUND
the crucible flips no contract feature and edits no product file
